evidence.quote: PHOENIX GX – die neuen leistungsstarken Vielzweckgeräte für die Holz- und Metallackierung sowie sonstige Beschichtungen in Industrie und Handwerk.
Airblast Eurospray Ltd. designed a system consisting of two WIWA Fleximix I 3 K (three component) systems which supply two spray booths.
For priming KEMPF employs an electric WIWA FLEXIMIX II for two colors which draws the primers out of 200 liter barrels.
For applying paint, which is now used in more than 400 different color shades here, an electric WIWA 3K FLEXIMIX in the low-pressure range is utilized.
